project_type: Full-stack rugby video analysis app - Python FastAPI backend + React TypeScript frontend
build_system: uv (backend), npm + vite (frontend), Makefile at root
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (backend tests/unit/), vitest with @testing-library/react (frontend src/__tests__/)
test_command: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/ -v && cd ../frontend && npm run test -- --run
verification_instructions: 1. Run backend tests: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/ -v. 2. Run frontend tests: cd frontend && npm run test -- --run. 3. Build frontend: cd frontend && npm run build.
setup_instructions: cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm install
environment_constraints: No Docker daemon available for runtime testing. Use host-based validation. Python 3.11 required. Node.js required for frontend.
contribution_requirements: Hexagonal architecture with SOLID principles. Backend uses ports/adapters pattern. Tests required.
key_patterns: Frontend: React functional components with hooks, zustand store, recharts for charts, lucide-react icons, tailwindcss styling, vitest tests. Backend: FastAPI router pattern, Pydantic models, dataclass-based analytics engine, service layer pattern with app.state injection. Types defined in frontend/src/types/index.ts shared with backend models.
directory_structure: Root: Makefile, docker-compose files, README. backend/src/: main.py, api/routes/ (analysis, video, ai, health, plays, calibration), cv/ (analytics, detector, tracker), services/ (analysis_service, background_tasks, play_detection_service), core/ (enums, models), config/, adapters/. frontend/src/: App.tsx, main.tsx, pages/ (AnalysisPage), components/ (11 components), stores/ (analysisStore), services/ (api, websocket), types/, __tests__/.
